name: Quaker Instant Oatmeal (Maple & Brown Sugar)
whyItWorks: Rolled oats cut fine and pre-steamed so they soften instantly with hot water. The soluble beta-glucan forms a soothing gel that bulks stool gently without abrasive roughness.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Empty packet into bowl, add 1/2 cup boiling water, stir and let sit for 1 minute.
